title: Designing a plug-in system with polymorphism
answer: Define a small plug-in interface that captures the stable operation, implement that interface in independent plug-in classes, and have the host depend only on the interface. Discover or register implementations through configuration, dependency injection, `ServiceLoader`, or an explicit registry, then invoke them polymorphically. AeroTopo already follows this direction with contracts such as `Exportable` and `ElevationStrategy`; a plug-in architecture extends the same idea by separating implementation discovery from invocation.
